source: Forever racial talents reference + race/class matrix

races.name: Orc
races.description: Focused, ferocious, and sometimes monstrous, the Horde values strength and honor, but struggles to keep aggression in check.

abilities.name: Blood Fury
abilities.description: Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Shatter Curse
abilities.description: Immunity to Curses and Banes and reduce Magical damage taken for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Axe Specialization
abilities.description: Axes increase spell and ability critical chance by 1%.

abilities.name: Hardiness
abilities.description: Stun durations decreased by 20%.

races.name: Undead
races.description: The plague of undeath was unleashed upon the land, and those who survived are the Forsaken.

abilities.name: Will of the Forsaken
abilities.description: Removes Charm, Fear, and Sleep effects.

abilities.name: Cannibalize
abilities.description: When activated, regenerates 35% of total health and mana over 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yards. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect.

abilities.name: Underwater Breathing
abilities.description: Underwater breath lasts 300% longer.

abilities.name: Touch of the Grave
abilities.description: Your attacks and harmful spells have a chance to drain life from the target, healing you.

races.name: Tauren
races.description: The peaceful Tauren have long roamed the central plains, but now their way of life is under threat.

abilities.name: War Stomp
abilities.description: Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yards for 2 sec.

abilities.name: Cultivation
abilities.description: Grow bonus herbs that don't require Herbalism to gather.

abilities.name: Plainstrunning
abilities.description: Gain increased movement speed the longer you remain moving.

abilities.name: Endurance
abilities.description: Total Health increased by 5% and Hit Chance increased by 1%.

races.name: Troll
races.description: The savage and mysterious Trolls are known for their regeneration and their affinity for the elements.

abilities.name: Walk on Air
abilities.description: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Skysight
abilities.description: Receive an Elemental Blessing increasing run speed by 10%.

abilities.name: Wind Blessed
abilities.description: 1% increased melee, ranged, and spellcasting Haste.

abilities.name: Elemental Insight
abilities.description: Damage to Elementals increased by 5%.

races.name: Skyborne
races.description: Skyborne of the Horde — Forever race. Racial abilities TBD.

races.name: Human
races.description: Humans are versatile and ambitious, bringing their technical, arcane, and spiritual wisdom toward the goal of a peaceful world.

abilities.name: Will to Survive
abilities.description: Removes all Stun effects.

abilities.name: Perception
abilities.description: Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec.

abilities.name: Sword Specialization
abilities.description: Swords increase spell and ability critical chance by 2%.

abilities.name: The Human Spirit
abilities.description: Spirit increased by 5%.

races.name: Dwarf
races.description: The ancient Dwarves are known for their engineering prowess, their resistance, and their love of treasure.

abilities.name: Find Treasure
abilities.description: Allows the dwarf to sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap.

abilities.name: Stoneform
abilities.description: Removes all Poison and Disease effects and reduces Physical damage taken for 8 sec.

abilities.name: Mace Specialization
abilities.description: Maces increase spell and ability critical chance by 1%.

abilities.name: Big Game Hunter
abilities.description: Damage to Beasts increased by 5%.

races.name: Night Elf
races.description: The mysterious and ageless Night Elves possess an innate connection to nature and a mastery of the shadows.

abilities.name: Elune's Light
abilities.description: Increases critical chance by 10% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Shadowmeld
abilities.description: Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Any threat is restored versus enemies still in combat upon cancellation of this effect.

abilities.name: Quickness
abilities.description: 1% increased Dodge chance and 2% increased run speed.

abilities.name: Wisp Spirit
abilities.description: Transform into a wisp upon death, increasing speed by 75% while dead.

races.name: Gnome
races.description: Gnomes are brilliant and eccentric inventors, known for their quick wits and expansive minds.

abilities.name: Eureka!
abilities.description: Your next 5 spells or heals cost less and deal or heal 10% more.

abilities.name: Expansive Mind
abilities.description: Maximum Mana increased by 5%.

abilities.name: Engineering Specialization
abilities.description: Engineering skill increased.

abilities.name: Escape Artist
abilities.description: Escape the effects of any immobilization or movement speed reduction effect.

races.name: Skyborne
races.description: Skyborne of the Alliance — Forever race. Racial abilities TBD.
